title: Native-comp cache closure

environment.system_features: ACL GMP GNUTLS LIBSELINUX LIBXML2 MODULES NATIVE_COMP NOTIFY INOTIFY PDUMPER SECCOMP SQLITE3 THREADS TREE_SITTER ZLIB

mechanism: Emacs native compilation introduces ABI-sensitive cache and runtime-library state that must be owned by the rootfs or sandbox cache.
hypothesis: The probe should record native-comp availability, eln load paths, and whether cache-like paths are sandbox-owned or development-classified.
minimal_fixture: The current Emacs runtime variables related to native compilation.
predicted_behavior: Development mode may include host Emacs native-lisp paths, but production benchmark evidence needs rootfs-owned ABI and cache manifests.
counterexample: Ignoring native-comp paths can hide stale `.eln' artifacts compiled against a different Emacs or libgccjit ABI.
derived_gym_requirement: The rootfs contract must record native-comp enablement, libgccjit identity, eln paths, and sandbox-owned cache/write locations.
